facts.fact: A tender notice states the Ministry (MICSTI) requires consultants to review and evaluate the Lesotho Communications Policy 2008 and to draft a Lesotho Communications Policy (2025), with bids closing 21 July 2025; the page is undated and 2025-06 is its published proxy date.
The notice states MICSTI will review the Communications Policy 2008 and the Communications Act 2012 in collaboration with the Lesotho Communications Authority, which receives the bids.
